_comment_transport_mode: Options: 'apps_script' or 'direct_post'. Use 'apps_script' to tunnel traffic inside Google's CDN infrastructure to bypass severe state DPI censorship and IP filtering. Use 'direct_post' for direct-to-VPS high-speed low-latency transfers if the VPS IP is completely unfiltered.
_comment_debug_timing: When true, enables aggressive real-time latency telemetry logging, outputting rolling window percentile metrics (P50, P95, P99) directly to the console or logcat. Set to false in production to conserve device resources.
_comment_client_uuid: Commercial user identity. Set to a unique UUIDv4 string generated for each subscription. Master admin keys bypass quota limitations.
_comment_performance_mode: Options: 'latency' or 'throughput'. 'latency' minimizes server coalesce windows to 0 for instant chat/interactive surfing. 'throughput' maximizes bulk download capacity (e.g., YouTube/Instagram) by allowing larger packet grouping windows and parallel pooling.
_comment_auto_tune: When true, dynamically scales polling intervals based on P95 latency summaries. Set to false to strictly lock scheduling onto manual configurations.
_comment_compression_entropy_threshold: Threshold value (0-255, default 224). Intelligently skips Zstd compression over pre-encrypted data blocks to conserve client device battery and server CPU cycles.
